summary: Created implementation notes for AP2-1511 Duplicate Account Merge with updated LoyaltyMemberTier merge logic: take the tier with more points (highest BalanceStatusPoints__c), do not sum.
output: Implementation notes created. Key design decisions: (1) LMT merge takes winner by BalanceStatusPoints__c, not sum. (2) Contact__c is non-reparentable Master-Detail — must copy values + delete, cannot reparent. (3) Follows DataUpdateBatch pattern for batch processing and anonymization. Components: DuplicateMergeBatch, DuplicateMergeService, DuplicateMergeBatchTest. 8 test scenarios defined.
